name: Trend RDS
summary: Trend RDS is a trend-following Expert Advisor that identifies market direction using a combination of moving averages and RDS-based signal logic, entering trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It uses fixed lot sizing and includes basic stop loss and take profit mechanisms for trade management. The EA is designed for medium-term timeframes and aims to capture sustained directional moves.
summary_zh: Trend RDS是一个趋势跟踪型EA，通过结合移动平均线和RDS信号逻辑来识别市场方向，沿当前趋势方向入场交易。它使用固定手数下单，并包含基本的止损和止盈机制来管理仓位。该EA专为中周期时间框架设计，旨在捕捉持续的方向性行情。
strategy_analysis: Trend RDS策略的核心概念是识别并跟随市场主流趋势方向进行交易。入场条件基于移动平均线的排列方向以及RDS信号指标的确认，当趋势方向一致时开仓做多或做空。出场条件包括达到预设的止盈目标、触发止损保护，以及趋势反转信号出现时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未发现动态加仓或马丁格尔成分。资金管理方面相对简单，依赖固定止损来控制单笔风险，但缺少基于账户权益百分比的动态仓位调整机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，但风险控制手段较为基础，缺乏高级的资金管理和仓位保护功能。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the Trend RDS strategy is to identify and follow the prevailing market trend direction. Entry conditions are based on moving average alignment and confirmation from the RDS signal indicator, opening long or short positions when the trend direction is consistent. Exit conditions include reaching preset take-profit targets, triggering stop-loss protection, and closing positions when a trend reversal signal appears. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with no dynamic position scaling or martingale components detected. Money management is relatively simple, relying on fixed stop-loss to control per-trade risk, but lacks dynamic position adjustment based on account equity percentage. The overall strategy logic is clear, but risk control measures are basic, lacking advanced money management and position protection features.
pros: 策略逻辑清晰易懂，适合趋势市场环境
使用固定止损保护每笔交易，限制单笔亏损
不使用马丁格尔或网格策略，避免了复利风险累积
代码结构相对简洁，便于理解和修改参数
顺应趋势交易，在强趋势行情中表现较好
pros_en: Clear and easy-to-understand strategy logic, suitable for trending market environments
Uses fixed stop-loss to protect each trade, limiting per-trade losses
Does not use martingale or grid strategies, avoiding compounding risk accumulation
Relatively clean code structure, easy to understand and modify parameters
Trend-following approach performs well in strong trending markets
cons: 在震荡市或区间行情中容易产生频繁亏损信号
固定手数仓位管理缺乏灵活性，未根据账户风险动态调整
缺少移动止损或保本止损机制，可能导致盈利回吐
对滑点和点差缺乏过滤，可能在不利条件下入场
策略依赖单一趋势判断指标，缺乏多维度确认
cons_en: Prone to frequent losing signals in choppy or range-bound markets
Fixed lot sizing lacks flexibility, not dynamically adjusted based on account risk
Lacks trailing stop or breakeven mechanisms, potentially giving back profits
No spread or slippage filter, may enter under unfavorable conditions
Strategy relies on single trend determination indicator, lacks multi-dimensional confirmation
improvements: 增加基于账户权益百分比的动态仓位管理
添加移动止损和保本止损功能以保护浮动盈利
加入震荡市过滤器（如ADX或ATR）以避免在非趋势行情中交易
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage
Implement trailing stop and breakeven functionality to protect floating profits
Add a choppy market filter (such as ADX or ATR) to avoid trading in non-trending conditions

risk_points: 固定手数未根据账户规模动态调整，大账户可能过度集中风险
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线内重复开仓
没有点差过滤，高点差环境可能显著影响交易结果
risk_points_en: Fixed lot sizing not dynamically adjusted for account size, large accounts may have over-concentrated risk
Lacks new bar check mechanism, may repeatedly open positions within the same bar
No spread filter, high-spread environments may significantly impact trading results

summary_en: Trend RDS is a trend-following Expert Advisor that identifies market direction using a combination of moving averages and RDS-based signal logic, entering trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It uses fixed lot sizing and includes basic stop loss and take profit mechanisms for trade management. The EA is designed for medium-term timeframes and aims to capture sustained directional moves.
